argv:
import json, pathlib, re, subprocess
m = pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation")
arch = m / "progress-archive/2026-10-18.md"
assert arch.is_file(), "missing progress-archive/2026-10-18.md"
in_head = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-replace-objects", "cat-file", "-e", "HEAD:" + arch.as_posix()], capture_output=True).returncode == 0
base_ref = "HEAD~1" if in_head else "HEAD"
assert subprocess.run(["git", "--no-replace-objects", "cat-file", "-e", base_ref + ":" + arch.as_posix()], capture_output=True).returncode != 0, "archive file existed in base"
for prev in ("2026-10-14_15.md", "2026-10-15_16.md", "2026-10-16.md"):
    assert subprocess.run(["git", "--no-replace-objects", "diff", "--quiet", base_ref, "--", (m / "progress-archive" / prev).as_posix()]).returncode == 0, prev
old_text = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-replace-objects", "show", base_ref + ":" + (m / "PROGRESS.md").as_posix()], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
prog_text = (m / "PROGRESS.md").read_text()
arch_text = arch.read_text()
title = "# Progress Archive — 2026-10-18 (stale sections moved in T-091)"
assert arch_text.startswith(title + "\n"), arch_text.splitlines()[:1]
assert prog_text.split("## ", 1)[0] == old_text.split("## ", 1)[0]
h2 = [ln for ln in prog_text.splitlines() if ln.startswith("## ")]
assert h2 == ["## Current status (2026-10-18)", "## Open decisions / waiting on the owner", "## Active lessons (candidates; none promoted through skillify)", "## Recent entries (newest first)"], h2
kept_h = h2[1:]
def section(text, heading):
    parts = text.split(heading + "\n", 1)
    assert len(parts) == 2, heading
    return parts[1].split("\n## ", 1)[0]
for h in kept_h:
    assert section(prog_text, h) == section(old_text, h), h
old_lines = old_text.splitlines()
keep_lines = set(old_text.split("## ", 1)[0].splitlines())
for h in kept_h:
    keep_lines.add(h)
    keep_lines.update(section(old_text, h).splitlines())
missing = [ln for ln in old_lines if ln not in set(prog_text.splitlines()) | set(arch_text.splitlines())]
assert not missing, ("removed lines missing from archive", missing[:3])
for ln in arch_text.splitlines():
    if ln.strip() and ln != title:
        assert ln in old_lines, ln
i = 0
while i < len(old_lines):
    if old_lines[i].startswith("## ") and old_lines[i] not in kept_h:
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(old_lines) and not old_lines[j].startswith("## "):
            j += 1
        block = "\n".join(old_lines[i:j]).rstrip("\n")
        assert block in arch_text and block not in prog_text, old_lines[i]
        i = j
    else:
        i += 1
for ln in old_lines:
    if ln.strip() and ln not in keep_lines:
        assert ln not in prog_text.splitlines(), ln
cs = prog_text.split("## Current status (2026-10-18)\n", 1)[1].split("\n## ", 1)[0]
assert "Gate 0 passed" not in cs and "Gate 1 passed" not in cs and "next gate:" not in cs and "23:50" not in cs and "429" not in cs
assert "mission/2a-foundation" in cs and "2A Foundation" in cs
goal = (m / "GOAL.md").read_text()
for key in ("status", "owner", "orchestrator"):
    val = re.search(r"^" + key + r":\s*(\S+)", goal, re.M).group(1)
    assert (key + ": " + val) in cs, (key, val)
assert "F002 is removed" in goal and "F002 removed" in cs
features = json.loads((m / "features.json").read_text())["features"]
acc_expected = [(f["id"], f["accepted_run_id"]) for f in features if f["passes"]]
open_expected = [f["id"] for f in features if not f["passes"]]
acc_line = [ln for ln in cs.splitlines() if ln.startswith("- **Features:**")][0]
acc_part, open_part = acc_line.split("; open (passes: false):", 1)
assert re.findall(r"(F\d{3}) \(([0-9a-f-]{36})\)", acc_part) == acc_expected
assert re.findall(r"F\d{3}", acc_part) == [fid for fid, _ in acc_expected]
assert re.findall(r"F\d{3}", open_part.split("(", 1)[0]) == open_expected
fleet = json.loads((m / "fleet.json").read_text())
assert ("schema_version " + str(fleet["schema_version"])) in cs
assert ("billing_classes: " + json.dumps(fleet["policy"]["billing_classes"])) in cs
assert ("fast: " + str(fleet["policy"]["fast"]).lower()) in cs
assert ("no_zdr: " + json.dumps(fleet["policy"]["no_zdr"])) in cs
seat_expected = {k: (v["approved_resolution"]["provider"], v["approved_resolution"]["model"], v["approved_resolution"]["effort"], v["approved_resolution"]["speed"]) for k, v in fleet["seats"].items()}
seat_found = {k: (p, mod, eff, spd) for k, p, mod, eff, spd in re.findall(r"([a-z]+(?:\.[a-z]+)?)=([a-z]+)/([a-z0-9._-]+)/([a-z]+)/([a-z]+)", cs)}
assert seat_found == seat_expected, (seat_found, seat_expected)
rows = [json.loads(ln) for ln in (m / "routing-data.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
runs = [r for r in rows if "run_id" in r]
done = [r for r in runs if r.get("outcome") == "done"]
rev = [r for r in rows if r.get("type") == "review-calibration"]
seed = [r for r in rows if r.get("type") == "seeded-calibration"]
assert f"routing-data.jsonl: {len(rows)} rows ({len(runs)} runs, {len(done)} done, {len(rev)} review-calibration, {len(seed)} seeded-calibration)" in cs
for pth in sorted((m / "progress-archive").glob("*.md")):
    assert ("progress-archive/" + pth.name) in cs, pth.name
for _, rid in acc_expected:
    assert (m / "verification" / f"{rid}.json").is_file(), rid
receipts_dir = pathlib.Path(".tasks/receipts")
if receipts_dir.is_dir() and list(receipts_dir.glob("*.json")):
    for _, rid in acc_expected:
        assert (receipts_dir / f"{rid}.json").is_file(), rid
print("ok")
